items.text: All four round-001 decisions answered and incorporated into plan.md: D1=B (API-side normalization), D2=A (boolean accepted_as_proposed field, no sentinel string in selected), D3=A (reject legacy __other__+freeform writes with a 400 + helpful migration message; read-side tolerant via decision-show normalization), D4=A (decision-add stays implicit — empty options[] continues to encode single-proposal intent, no new flag).

Plan updates: Contract Decisions section now records D1-D4 as committed (was TBD for D2/D3/D4). Implementation Strategy Phase 1 step 2 simplified to a single approach (boolean field, selected stays null) — sentinel-string variant removed. Phase 2 step 2 broadened to reject any --selected on single-proposal writes, not just the __other__ pattern. Testing Plan reorganized: collapsed two sentinel-related cases, added explicit legacy-rejection test (write) and legacy-normalization test (read). Target End State, Scope, Non-Goals, Risks, and Definition of Done updated to reflect the boolean-field choice and the implicit-flag stance.

Cross-initiative implication for orchestrator: sibling fix `prompt-manager-decision-show-options-default-output` overlaps on decision-show output formatting. The executing agent should sequence these two fixes so the 'accepted as proposed' rendering and the always-show-options-block change land consistently. Both belong to initiative prompt-manager-decision-workflow-polish (6 members, 2 completed). Three-surface parity rule (API + CLI + UI in one PR) is reaffirmed in the plan.
Readiness: all five dimensions at 3/3. No remaining gaps. Plan is ready to queue for execution.

plan_updates: Incorporated all round-001 decisions (D1=B, D2=A, D3=A, D4=A) into plan.md. Removed TBD placeholders, simplified Phase 1 storage approach to the boolean field, broadened the write-reject rule to any --selected on single-proposal decisions, and tightened the Testing Plan to cover the legacy write-rejection and read-side normalization paths explicitly.
